'''Poul Jens''' is the blacksmith of [[Aturo's Orchard]] and sits on the [[Village Council]].
== History ==
Poul Jens has been the village blacksmith for nearly twenty years, and plans on working the smithy for nearly twenty more. He is well-liked and well-respected in the community for his fine smithing skill and his humble manner.<ref name="RPG">''[[The Wheel of Time Roleplaying Game]]''</ref>
